catalog.gear_market: GEAR MARKET — Mechanical equipment uses only these supported categories: staff/wand (weapon); shield/buckler (offhand); plate armor/plate armour (armor); robes/robe (armor); sword/longsword (weapon). Use a recognized kind in a combat equipment offer's name; appearance may vary freely. Only the engine fixes its values. No extra head, leg, hand or jewelry slots or bonuses. Separate armor parts are not whole armor. Ordinary tools, clothes and decoration remain available, explicitly without combat stats. F staff MATK by actual quality: common 6, fine 8, superior 10, exceptional 12; starter staff MATK 10. For requested upgrades, a suitable specialist may offer genuinely finer/superior/exceptional supported ware; do not keep offering common gear under expensive material names. If no upgrade is available, say so. Copper/silver cores and higher prices alone grant no stats. Keep the named quality and price stable; armour/offhand, consumables and supported Skill manuals are other voluntary improvements.
